title: Research Report Summarizer — 研报摘要提取器
description: Implement key viewpoint and investment thesis extraction from Chinese analyst research reports. The summarizer MUST identify report structure (title, author, conclusion, key points), extract analyst rating (buy/hold/sell/overweight/underweight), target price, generate concise thesis summary (1-3 sentences), and identify risk factors. Depends on F-041 NER Engine for entity recognition and F-039 Sentiment Classifier for sentiment labeling.

criteria: ResearchReportResult frozen dataclass with 8 fields: [report_title, analyst_name, institution, rating, target_price, thesis_summary, key_points, risk_factors]
5 rating types: [buy, hold, sell, overweight, underweight]
12+ unit tests pass: verify by py -m pytest tests/unit/test_report_summarizer.py -p no:asyncio -q (exit code 0)
All frozen dataclasses use frozen=True, slots=True pattern

implementation.title: Implement ReportSummarizer
implementation.description: Create synapse/nlp/report_summarizer.py with ReportSummarizer.summarize(text: TextDocument) -> ResearchReportResult. Pipeline: (1) TextPreprocessor, (2) NEREngine for analyst/institution, (3) Structure parsing (title, sections), (4) Rating extraction, (5) Target price extraction, (6) Thesis summary generation (first 1-3 sentences of conclusion), (7) Key points extraction (bullet points), (8) Risk factor identification.
logic_flow: Extract analyst name and institution via NER
Generate thesis summary from conclusion section
Extract key points from bullet/numbered lists
Identify risk factors from risk section
